evidence_summary: Current official team page describes Dream Big as a network of freelancers that works together when projects need different skills and explicitly invites freelance professionals with P.IVA in web design, programming, apps, graphics and digital communication to join the Dream Team.
why_high_value: Explicit P.IVA freelance network, web-design/programming demand, project-based team assembly and WordPress-led founder create a strong recurring collaboration fit for VDS.
verified_facts: Dream Big explicitly calls itself a network of freelancers.
The official team page explicitly seeks freelance professionals with P.IVA.
Web design and programming are explicitly included.
Founder Gaia specializes in WordPress websites.
inferences: Exact current volume of external WordPress development work is not stated.
A VDS technical/performance overflow angle appears plausible but must be presented as a proposal, not as an existing vacancy.
safe_alternative_angles: Use the official contact route to propose joining the freelance network as a complementary WordPress/frontend/performance/technical-production specialist.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not guess or derive an email address.
Do not claim Dream Big currently has a specific paid WordPress assignment unless verified.
recommended_human_checks: Open the official Contattami route and confirm submission fields.
Confirm whether portfolio/CV upload is requested; attachment approval protocol applies if so.
Position VDS as complementary technical capacity rather than competing general web design.
